description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

The status bonus a Signal declaration grants increases from +2 to +3. At the same time, the damage you take when a Signal effect fails increases from 2 force damage per level to 3 force damage per level. The Signal Drift point is unchanged: still 1, still every time. Both halves of this feat are permanent and neither can be declined on a given effect.

cinderfall.incomplete: Signal's status bonus rises from +2 to +3; Signal-failure damage rises from 2/level to 3/level. Both numbers modify a mechanic that itself has no character-sheet representation to attach a '+1 more' delta to. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`).
